sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for breadcrumb trail
sections.what: Brings in the link component, the current page path reader, the arrow icon, and the React library.
sections.why: The trail needs the current address, links between pages, and arrow separators.

sections.name: Breadcrumbs
sections.title: Path based breadcrumb trail
sections.what: Reads the current address and splits it into parts, such as Reports then Upload. Each earlier part becomes a link, and the last part is shown in bold without a link. Nothing shows on the home page or top level pages.
sections.why: Helps users know where they are and move back up the page path.
sections.watch_out: Labels come straight from the address text by capitalizing the first letter, so an address part like a patient id will appear as a raw value.

summary: A trail of links such as Home, Reports and Upload that shows where the user is in the app.
purpose: Helps the patient see where they are and step back up a level.
why: Header says dynamic path tracking for clinical navigation. The reason it is hidden on the home page is noted only in a comment.
how: Reads the current web address, splits it into parts, and builds a link for each part. The last part is plain text. The trail is hidden when there is only one part.
inputs: The current page address from the router.
outputs: A row of links and plain text.
risks: Labels come straight from the address with only the first letter capitalized. Ids or raw words in an address show as they are.
debug: If labels look wrong, check the names used in the page addresses. If the trail is missing, check how many parts the address has.
